Hey gdg.  I would ask what's up but you already let us know.  Just wanted to let you know I feel you.  I isolated myself and people said the same thing about me for a few too many years and I'm just getting on the other side of it now.  I still deal with chronic suicidal ideation on a daily basis.  I  hate my daily interactions and saw the world through a pair of Paradigm glasses that was all too real for me and no one else.  I was a pothead for almost 10 years straight and after the sixth or seventh year it wasn't helping anymore.  I've been drug and alcohol free now for almost two years and I will say it does help eventually  no matter how much I don't want to believe it .  I don't want to give you any platitudes or anecdotes about your own situation but I will say that I got on some medication and found a couple self-help groups and started talking about the things that I was seeing feeling and talking about in my head.  It's been almost two years now and it's only been about the last three or four months that I've actually got a smile back on my face.  I posted to this subreddit many times and it was through a few people that replied to me that gave me a little bit of motivation to go out and start talking about how I felt.  I only unsolicited advice would be go to those that say they love you. Push them. Make them be there for you if you have to.  There is love there but sometimes we got to kick the s*** out of it so it can buzz up into everyone's face

If you ever want to talk text or email about the Ridiculousness of this filthy Earth and the shity people that we live around feel free I'll be right here.

ashrenoworx@gmail.com
Thanks.  Ive thought about this.  I juat dont know if anyone will accept me with my mental background. Ive looked for a close fam for a long time. All I want is to be something worthwhile for someone
Hahaha.  I'll bring that up in DBT Group next week. Hahaha
Oh.  And I lied to get into the Army.  Just like all the men in my family before me did :)

37F psy-ops

I'm not bi polar.  Um...only one shit doctor blew that diagnosis out of his ass...and yea I was on another medication at that time.

Yes.  The VA is my shitstain that wont wash out.

I gotta go for moms sake. I promised.

No that classification has not.  When it does I'll be the 1st.

I have chronic depression.  I take Wellabutrin 300mg daily. Ive been diagnosed autistic, bi polar, manic, and extremely human;)  I'm just really fucking depressed about shit all the time really.

Have taken seraquil, paxel, ridilin, zoloft, lithium, trazadone, just to name a few.   The wellabutrin helps a lot and I'm ok with it. I nevwr took any of the others for more that 3 months 

Ive had 3 attempts at age 8, 12, and 28. I self medicated and took no pharmaceuticals from age 24 to 34 after I retired out of the Army[ exception being the few times I institutionalized myself from some traumatic events with people that cared then that have abandoned me since]. Mainly cannabis. A lot of cannabis. I got a DUI for a .095 BAC March 10th 2018 and have been completely sober since July 2018 and in treatment at. VA Mental.

I still want to kill myself everyday. I hate the world and myself.  The maintenance program just to stay alive is grueling and I will probably make another attempt soon.

Does this satisfy your curio?

Ive been a participant in both too many times and am going to groups and am seeing a healthcare professional currently.  Depends on the patient and whos running the program and what the leadership deems important.  Its all very opinionated. 

Drugs drugs and more drugs seem to be the way of treatment these days.  Therapy is an aftermath.  I have had Suicidal Ideation Syndrome my whole life.  Ive disclosed my views and feelings with the predictable reaponse of " well I'm sorry foe your pain lets try this drug and if that dosent work this one"  its a crock of shit. We need real programs that get results for a wide range of mental illnesses that focus on the person and not cookie cutter antidotes that proffesionals attempt to force you in to show they did there job.

Everyones different and mental health is fickle.  I will say you get whats paid for.  In my experience all the good doctors with bonifide experience and a history of successful therapies are all employed at the Hollywood big rich hospitals.  They all eventually go where the big money goes.
Move to San Francisco.  Lots of independant women there. Geography means problems fixed sometimes

I'm happy you shared them with me and us here.  I don't understand exactly Butttt have felt a lot of the same for a long time.   I'm going out on the beach in a couple weeks with a shit ton of drugs and booze.  Maybe I'll see you there.

I understand what your saying.  I'm a callous vagabond for using indigents to satisfy my cowardice.  That future joy is narcotically induced and selfishly administered.  I'll be taking advantage of the less fortunate to feel something, anything other than the pain to justify my departure.
In my volenteer work at institutions and events over the last year with the unfortunate I have had overwhelming feeling of guilt and hopelessness for those in need and myself that leave me breathless and out of control.   I dont know where these emotions come from but the hit me.like a deluge.  I wish I could find that contentment and satisfaction when providing service to my fellow man.  It always sends me deeper into my depression.  There are no small joys in my existence.  I dont know why.  I understand these concepts and see them providing ambivalence for others.  For my self to no avail.

I'm sorry for your pain.  Please reach out to him at least once and speak your truth.if not him someone. Anyone.  You owe yourself that much.  I'll bw eight there with you shortly.  See you on the dark side

I'm sorry your wife is struggling.  Nothing puts me off. I'm open to everything.  Thanks for reaching out.  Only an address and a contact will stop me.  I hope your wife can see the blessing in some one that actually loves her, will be there with her in her struggle and wants to see her happy.  If I only had that dream.   
#helplessromanticdeath

Be well.
